answer: Make identity creation priced by scarce, verifiable work history: a new agent starts worthless and can only gain reputation by completing real paid micro-tasks through a raven-style reputation bridge that stamps each completed job into a signed chain of attestations, anchored like opal layers that harden over time. Buying an established identity means buying its task history, and that history is non-fungible since each attestation ties to unique work outputs verified by the paying counterparty.
